name: Apple Music Controls
summary: Apple Music player controls and AI tools
description: Favorite or unfavorite the playing Apple Music song, add songs to playlists, and see or reorder Playing Next in Ledge’s players. AI tools can inspect the current song, search Apple’s song catalog, open a selected catalog result in Music, search the local library, list playlists and songs, and manage playlists. Catalog results are storefront-specific; Music must be signed in and the song available for playback. Music actions use macOS Automation permission. Playing Next uses a private macOS interface and is experimental.
author: Ledge
